answer: The farms count on nobody checking; Syrup boiler ointment pot seal kept in the herb store checks, and it checks each ointment pot is a measured herb yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must. The market sells proofs one at a time at 99 POA; 554 proofs sell for 54846 POA, and there is no wholesale price. The orchard sits in one office, the cedar sits in one ledger, and the thread sits in one archive — and the three never meet except through the applicant. Every proof the farm forges is another witness against it, and the witnesses are all public.
